summary: Quaternion SLERP-style blend: loads a 4-component quaternion from a6, optionally negates all components for a shortest-path sign when the c0/c3 flag pair is clear, applies angular offsets read from the a7 pointer, then runs a sequence of indirect-thunk float computations whose results are written as quaternion outputs to a1 and a2 (this+0x0..this+0xC each) while the adjusted source quaternion is written to a3.

operations.description: Load the four quaternion components of the a6 input into locals v21..v24.
If the c0/c3 flag pair (v8|v9) is zero, negate all four components (v17..v20) and store into v21..v24 — a shortest-path quaternion sign adjustment.
v25 = v22 - *(a7 + 4); v26 = v23 - *(a7 + 8) — angular offsets applied to two components from the a7 pointer.
j_ShortComputation_de19 float helper invoked (repeatedly, interleaved with the indirect thunks) to compute SLERP weighting terms.
ThunkViaIndirectJump indirect thunk executed as part of the interpolation weight computation.
IndirectJumpThunk indirect thunk executed as part of the interpolation weight computation.
IndirectJumpThunk_e0d3 indirect thunk executed in the accumulation/interpolation step.
v14 = v11 + v25; v15 = v12 + v26 — combine thunk results with the angular offsets.
Write first output quaternion to a1: component at this+0x0 = v13, this+0x4 = v14, this+0x8 = v15, this+0xC = v16.
Write second output quaternion to a2: component at this+0x0 = v13, this+0x4 = v14, this+0x8 = v15, this+0xC = v16.
Write the adjusted source quaternion components v21..v24 to a3 at this+0x0..this+0xC.
Return the result of the final j_ShortComputation_de19 call.

unresolved: The exact decomposition of the four thunk calls (argument register/stack state at each call site) is lost to indirect-jump decompilation; only the execution order and the final combine (v14/v15) are grounded.
Whether a1 and a2 receive interpolated quaternions or quaternion derivatives (v13..v16 vs v21..v24) is not resolvable from the packet alone.
The a7 pointer components at +4 and +8 are read but their role as angular offsets is DERIVED, not independently evidenced.
Static global flt_5ADE48 is recorded as read but never appears in the decompiled body — likely consumed inside the indirect thunk callees.
